notes: All performance comparisons are diagnostic-only and use paired distributions with seeded bootstrap intervals.
The two final-head unprofiled replications cover 20 measured pairs after six total warm-up pairs.
Deep profiler captures predate the hydration-only source change and are retained as historical diagnostic evidence, not final-head gates.
Raw results, profiles, traces, and logs remain external artifacts; this file preserves selected metrics and provenance.

multipleComparisons.family: all reported metrics within each case

warnings: Per-metric bootstrap intervals and improvement/regression classifications are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons; do not interpret them as family-wise significance or performance gates.
